name: turso
description: A Pulumi package for creating and managing Turso resources.

apiToken.description: The Turso API token. Can also be set via the TURSO_API_TOKEN environment variable. If not provided, the provider will attempt to use the Turso CLI authentication.

organization.description: The Turso organization slug. Can also be set via the TURSO_ORGANIZATION environment variable.

hostname.description: The hostname of this database instance.

name.description: The name of this database instance.

region.description: The region where this instance is located.

type.description: The type of instance (primary or replica).

uuid.description: The unique identifier of this instance.

name.description: The name of the database to seed from (when type is 'database') or the URL of the dump file (when type is 'dump').

timestamp.description: A specific point in time to seed from. Only applies when seeding from a database.

type.description: The type of seed to use.

enum.description: Uses an database to seed the new database.
Uses a database dump to seed the new database.

turso:index:Database.description: A Turso database. Databases are SQLite databases that live in a group and can be replicated across multiple regions.

blockReads.description: Whether read queries to this database are blocked.

blockWrites.description: Whether write queries to this database are blocked.

dbId.description: The unique identifier of the database.

deleteProtection.description: Whether deletion protection is enabled for this database.

group.description: The name of the group this database belongs to.

hostname.description: The hostname to connect to this database.

instances.description: A map of database instances by region.

primaryRegion.description: The primary region where the database is located.

regions.description: All regions where this database has replicas.

sizeLimit.description: The maximum size limit of the database.

blockReads.description: When true, read queries to this database will be blocked.

blockWrites.description: When true, write queries to this database will be blocked.

group.description: The name of the group where the database belongs. The group must already exist.

name.description: The name of the database. Must be unique within the organization.

seed.description: Configuration for seeding the database from an existing database or dump.

sizeLimit.description: The maximum size of the database in bytes. You can use units like '1gb', '500mb', etc.

turso:index:DatabaseToken.description: An authentication token for a Turso database. Tokens can be used to connect to the database with specific permissions.

authorization.description: The authorization level for the token. Defaults to full-access if not specified.

database.description: The name of the database to create the token for.

expiration.description: The duration until the token expires (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). If not specified, the token will not expire.

expiresAt.description: The RFC3339 timestamp when the token expires, if an expiration was set.

readAttach.description: List of databases that can be attached for read operations using this token.

token.description: The JWT token used to authenticate with the database.

authorization.description: The authorization level for the token. Defaults to full-access if not specified.

database.description: The name of the database to create the token for.

expiration.description: The duration until the token expires (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). If not specified, the token will not expire.

readAttach.description: List of databases that can be attached for read operations using this token.

turso:index:Group.description: A Turso group. Groups are collections of databases that share the same replication configuration and can be managed together.

deleteProtection.description: Whether deletion protection is enabled for this group.

locations.description: All locations where this group has database instances.

primary.description: The primary location of the group.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the group.

extensions.description: SQLite extensions to enable for databases in this group. Use 'all' to enable all available extensions, or specify individual extension names.

name.description: The name of the group. Must be unique within the organization.

primaryLocation.description: The primary location (region) for the group. This is where the primary database instance will be created.

replicaLocations.description: Additional locations where database replicas will be created.

turso:index:GroupToken.description: An authentication token for a Turso group. Tokens can be used to connect to any database in the group with specific permissions.

authorization.description: The authorization level for the token. Defaults to full-access if not specified.

expiration.description: The duration until the token expires (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). If not specified, the token will not expire.

expiresAt.description: The RFC3339 timestamp when the token expires, if an expiration was set.

group.description: The name of the group to create the token for.

readAttach.description: List of databases that can be attached for read operations using this token.

token.description: The JWT token used to authenticate with databases in the group.

authorization.description: The authorization level for the token. Defaults to full-access if not specified.

expiration.description: The duration until the token expires (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). If not specified, the token will not expire.

group.description: The name of the group to create the token for.

readAttach.description: List of databases that can be attached for read operations using this token.
